hypothesis: Verifying the practice P raises unsupported attribution to outcome claims, holding supplier information fixed
intended_difference: Section 2 contains an audit record confirming P (A: 'No audit record is included')
held_fixed: system prompt; dossier (sections 1); task (section 3); case; identical closing filing notes (length not padded)
unavoidable_differences: A has no issuer/reference/date lines and is much shorter than B (per-cell lengths in COVERAGE_dev.md); B is a structured document, A a one-line note
primary_outcome: unsupported_q_obs (Q_obs marked established_true where gold does not accept it); components and composite reported (S3, S7)
alternatives_not_ruled_out: Presence of any official-looking record (authority/format) rather than what it checked: addressed by P2; document length (B is longer than A)
method: rate difference, boundary-valid case-clustered interval (method chosen by the §9 coverage simulation; not an ordinary bootstrap) and mixed-effects logistic (case random intercept); Holm across primary family
claim_boundary: 'Holding information fixed, a practice audit changes attribution of verification to outcome claims'. No claim about internal mechanism

hypothesis: The effect depends on what was verified (specificity)
intended_difference: Record checks the practice (B) vs a fire/building-safety item (D1)
held_fixed: system prompt; dossier (sections 1); task (section 3); case; identical closing filing notes (length not padded); issuer, audit reference, date, site, template fields, 'Status: Confirmed'
unavoidable_differences: Item/method/finding wording and length differ; practice is topically related to the outcome claims and Q_cause names the practice (this relatedness is the intended manipulation); lengths differ by the item/method/finding text only
primary_outcome: unsupported_q_obs (Q_obs marked established_true where gold does not accept it); components and composite reported (S3, S7)
alternatives_not_ruled_out: Topic-sensitive authority or lexical overlap between record and Q_cause rather than scope confusion; cannot be separated in this design
method: rate difference, boundary-valid case-clustered interval (method chosen by the §9 coverage simulation; not an ordinary bootstrap) and mixed-effects logistic (case random intercept); Holm across primary family
claim_boundary: B > D1 shows attribution depends on the checked topic; it does not by itself show a scope-reading failure

hypothesis: Stating audit coverage in prose reduces unsupported attribution
intended_difference: C adds a prose coverage statement after the identical record
held_fixed: system prompt; dossier (sections 1); task (section 3); case; identical closing filing notes (length not padded); identical audit record
unavoidable_differences: C is longer than B by exactly the coverage statement; coverage text names the indicator and 'cause', a lexical cue
primary_outcome: unsupported_q_obs (Q_obs marked established_true where gold does not accept it); components and composite reported (S3, S7)
alternatives_not_ruled_out: Lexical matching of 'did not assess' rather than reasoning; a general rise in caution (checked by P4 and false_refutation)
method: rate difference, boundary-valid case-clustered interval (method chosen by the §9 coverage simulation; not an ordinary bootstrap) and mixed-effects logistic (case random intercept); Holm across primary family
claim_boundary: Disclosure of coverage changes attribution; whether it does so without suppressing correct acceptance is P4

hypothesis: Coverage disclosure does not meaningfully suppress correct acceptance of audited outcome evidence (noninferiority)
intended_difference: E_scope adds a prose coverage statement after the identical outcome record
held_fixed: system prompt; dossier (sections 1); task (section 3); case; identical closing filing notes (length not padded); identical outcome record
unavoidable_differences: E_scope coverage names the practice as not assessed (C's names the indicator): wording is parallel, not identical; E_scope is longer than E by exactly the coverage statement
alternatives_not_ruled_out: Selective caution vs. general caution is not separated by acceptance alone; check false_refutation and C − B together
method: one-sided paired noninferiority with a boundary-valid interval (score-type, cluster-adjusted; or exact/Bayesian), chosen by simulated coverage near 0 and 1; margin delta OPEN (proposal 5 percentage points)
claim_boundary: Only the CI excluding -delta shows preservation; a nonsignificant difference does not. Perfect acceptance in both arms bounds missed acceptance given enough independent cases. Preservation on these cases is not a mechanism of selective caution
